title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten named UCF spaces for focused work, collaborative projects, campus connection, and active breaks.

cards.title: Knowledge Commons
cards.subtitle: John C. Hitt Library, main floor
cards.notes: Bring a laptop and choose a seat that matches your task; the commons combines desktop stations, power access, soft seating, and group-study settings.
cards.short_summary: A large library learning and technology environment with varied seating and computers.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Libraries describes the Knowledge Commons as a 24,800-square-foot learning and technology environment with seating, desktop PCs, power access, soft seating, group settings, and portable whiteboards.
cards.source_title: John C. Hitt Library | UCF Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in the John C. Hitt Library; use it in accordance with library policies.

cards.title: Reading Room – Room 405
cards.subtitle: John C. Hitt Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Set up here when you want a quiet academic work session with room to spread out; keep conversations appropriately subdued for the library setting.
cards.short_summary: A fourth-floor quiet-study room with extensive seating and campus views.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Libraries identifies Room 405 as a quiet study space with 235 seats and a 270-degree view of the UCF campus.
cards.access_notes: Fourth floor of the John C. Hitt Library; follow posted quiet-study expectations.

cards.title: Silent Study – Room 450
cards.subtitle: John C. Hitt Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Use this room for reading, writing, or assignment work that needs minimal interruption; silence your phone and plan to work without conversation.
cards.short_summary: A designated no-talking study room with 131 seats.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Libraries states that Silent Study, Room 450, is a fourth-floor space for uninterrupted individual work with 131 seats; talking is prohibited.
cards.access_notes: Fourth floor of the John C. Hitt Library; cell phones must be silenced and talking is prohibited.

cards.title: Digital Exploration Center
cards.subtitle: Room 425, John C. Hitt Library
cards.notes: Visit when a class project needs digital experimentation or creative production; check with DEC staff about available tools, consultation, and programming.
cards.short_summary: A library hub for collaborative digital projects and immersive technology exploration.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Libraries describes the Digital Exploration Center as an interdisciplinary hub where students and faculty develop collaborative digital projects, explore immersive technologies, and pursue creative production.
cards.access_notes: Located in Room 425 of the John C. Hitt Library; staff support and programming are available.

cards.entity_name: John C. Hitt Library Study Rooms
cards.title: John C. Hitt Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: First, third, and fourth floors
cards.notes: Reserve a room before meeting your project group, then check in promptly; use the space for course-related work and respect its capacity limits.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms for group study and course-related work.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Libraries states that its study rooms support group study, are available to enrolled students, and can be reserved up to three days ahead for up to four hours per day.
cards.access_notes: Available to current UCF students, faculty, and staff; reservation and check-in rules apply.

cards.title: UCF Student Union
cards.subtitle: Central Orlando campus
cards.notes: Use the building as a central meetup point for studying, eating, attending events, or connecting between classes; consult the current schedule before planning.
cards.short_summary: UCF’s central student-life building for study, dining, events, meetings, and social time.
cards.evidence_claim: The UCF Student Union states that it provides space for the UCF community to study, socialize, eat, host events, attend meetings, celebrate traditions, and engage in campus life.
cards.access_notes: Operating hours and special hours vary with the academic calendar; check the Student Union page before visiting.

cards.title: Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.subtitle: UCF Main Campus
cards.notes: Plan an active break or a workout around the facility’s available areas; review recreation policies and current access details before arriving.
cards.short_summary: UCF’s main student recreation facility with fitness, courts, a track, climbing wall, and pools.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF identifies the Recreation and Wellness Center as its main student recreation facility, with fitness areas, courts, an indoor track, group-fitness rooms, a climbing wall, and an outdoor leisure pool.
cards.source_title: Recreation and Wellness Center | University of Central Florida
cards.access_notes: UCF Main Campus facility; check Recreation and Wellness Center policies and current hours before visiting.

cards.title: RWC Climbing Tower
cards.subtitle: Inside the Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.notes: Try an indoor climbing session at a route suited to your experience level, and follow staff direction plus all required climbing procedures and equipment rules.
cards.short_summary: A 41-foot indoor climbing tower with more than 20 top-rope routes.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Recreation and Wellness Center describes its Climbing Tower as a 41-foot indoor tower with more than 20 top-rope routes across a range of difficulties.
cards.source_title: Facilities | Recreation and Wellness Center | UCF
cards.access_notes: Located within the Recreation and Wellness Center; follow staff instructions and current facility procedures.

cards.title: MAC Gym
cards.subtitle: Recreation and Wellness Center multipurpose courts
cards.notes: Check whether a court is reserved, then use an open court for a casual activity; obtain any available equipment through the member services desk.
cards.short_summary: Two enclosed multipurpose courts within the Recreation and Wellness Center.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Recreation and Wellness Center states that the MAC Gym has two courts and that, when not reserved, the courts are first-come, first-served; equipment is available for checkout.
cards.source_title: Facilities | Recreation and Wellness Center | UCF
cards.access_notes: Court availability depends on reservations; check in with the member services desk for current use and equipment procedures.

cards.title: RWC Park Disc Golf Course
cards.subtitle: RWC Park, UCF Main Campus
cards.notes: Use daylight for a nine-hole round and bring or arrange appropriate disc equipment; share the outdoor space carefully with other campus users.
cards.short_summary: A nine-hole outdoor disc golf course at RWC Park.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Recreation and Wellness Center states that the RWC Park Disc Golf Course is a nine-hole course available to the UCF community and open during daylight hours every day.
cards.source_title: Facilities | Recreation and Wellness Center | UCF
cards.access_notes: Located in RWC Park; the facility page lists the course as open during daylight hours each day.
